Those who called on others to #StopAsianHate must also demand #JusticeForDaunteWright & declare #BlackLivesMatter 

We can only rid of anti-Asian racism when we rid of anti-Black racism. Our oppression & therefore our liberation are interlinked. 

Solidarity is the answer.

No matter the type of violence & how white supremacy will try to sow division, Black folks will have my love, care & solidarity forever. ✊🏽 

I know when #BlackLivesMatter we will also #StopAsianHate.

#JusticeForDaunteWright #DefundThePolice 

Music: 4Ever - Lil Mo https://t.co/OngK4xD8FW

Love & light to families of #GeorgeFloyd #MaKhiaBryant & all Black folx.

Even in a moment where there is some accountability for one officer, another shoots a 16 year old in the chest 4 times after she called for help.

Policing is beyond reform.

#SayHerName #BlackLivesMatter
